root_cause_label: Partial Spec Compliance Illusion (Pre-Quantization STFT + Peaks CSV Header Violation)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote peaks.csv without the required header and computed the STFT on the pre-quantization float signal rather than the WAV-derived int16 signal, then declared success without noticing either defect.
t_err_evidence: computes the STFT on the pre-quantization float signal instead of the PCM-int16 signal converted back to float
t_commit_evidence: After step 4, both scripts are written with their respective defects; the agent never modifies audioproc.py or solution.sh again, locking in both failures.
t_surface_evidence: peaks.csv: 0,14,21,28 / 1,14,21,28 -- no header row and identical peaks every frame
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on two unverified assumptions: (1) that computing the STFT on the pre-quantization float signal is equivalent to computing it on the WAV-restored signal, and (2) that the awk output did not require a CSV header — both are wrong per the task specification.
